title: Exact 16-PTY profile: every admission and committed-event sample within 100 ms

cases.summary: Sixteen one-line /usr/bin/head -n 1 terminals on one server (ideal-state.md:259 profile). All sixteen input.send admissions, all sixteen committed echo deliveries (each matched exactly at its own admission cursor) and all sixteen exit events must each answer within 100 ms of being awaited.
